metadata.description:
Get ready for a wild trip around the world with Wild Animal Trivia! This interactive audio game takes kids through 10 themed rounds covering ocean animals, rainforest creatures, bugs, safari animals, icy habitats, farmyard favorites, animal superpowers and some of the weirdest creatures on Earth.Each round includes three questions using a mix of clues, multiple choice, true-or-false facts and animal sounds. Kids can keep score as they go, earning one point for every correct answer, then add up their total at the end to see whether they’re a Jungle Explorer in Training, an Official Wildlife Ranger or an Ultimate Animal Master.Along the way, listeners will learn fascinating facts about blue whales, sloths, dung beetles, cheetahs, penguins, axolotls, narwhals and so many more. There are plenty of silly and surprising facts mixed in too, making the learning feel fun instead of like a quiz.Perfect for animal-loving kids who enjoy trivia, competition and discovering something new!Run Time: 28 min

Looking for other free audio sources, ideas and inspo? Maybe you want to submit a request for some sort of specific audio for your kids? Join my FB Group! I am always taking suggestions and working to get the audio your kids want.
